name: story-refinement
description: Judge a user story before it enters a backlog or a plan file.

acceptanceTestable.instructions: Does the acceptance criteria describe a check that fails before the change and passes after it?

criteria.true: names an observable outcome someone could assert on
criteria.false: states an intention, a quality, or a direction with nothing to assert

startable.instructions: Could a developer start this story without asking anyone a question first?

singlePurpose.instructions: Does this story describe one change, rather than several bundled together?
